keyword: why did artemis 2 go to the moon
claims: Artemis II went to the Moon.
Artemis II conducted the first crewed test flight of the Orion spacecraft and Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The primary goal of Artemis II was to test that life support, navigation, and thermal protection systems function correctly with humans on board in deep space.
Astronauts performed manual flying in the Orion capsule to test its systems.
Artemis II tested the "free return trajectory".
The "free return trajectory" uses the Moon's gravity to swing the spacecraft back to Earth without requiring significant engine burns.
The crew performed detailed observations of the lunar surface and geological features.
The observations provided high-resolution visual data for future landing sites.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II acts as a direct precursor to the Artemis III landing mission.
